newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P - Adef changes outlook on Arjil to developing.
newsitem.headline: S&P - Adef changes outlook on Arjil to developing.

text.p: Standard & Poor's French rating agency S&P-Adef said on Friday it had modified its creditwatch outlook on long-term notes of Banque Arjil, a unit of Groupe Lagardere, to "developing" from "negative".
It confirmed its T1 short-term rating.
It said the French government's decision to back an offer by Lagardere for Thomson and the terms of the offer could improve Banque Arjil's credit.
S&P-Adef said its modification of the outlook to developing meant that the long-term rating could later be lowered, raised or remain unchanged.
"S&P-Adef will follow closely developments on the takeover of Thomson SA by Groupe Lagardere, as and when more detailed information is available," it said in a statement.
The government announced on Wednesday it favoured Lagardere's offer for Thomson.
